heading: The Story of Ruth Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Ruth Bible crossword: Naomi, Moab, the barley harvest, Boaz and the kinsman redeemer. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A famine, a journey to Moab, three graves, and two widows on a road back to Bethlehem — one of whom will not go home. The Story of Ruth covers all four chapters: the gleaning in the field, the barley harvest, the threshingfloor at midnight, and the shoe plucked off at the gate to seal a bargain.
The book is short enough to read in a sitting, and worth reading before you solve. The closing verse is Ruth's answer on the road, which is the finest sentence in it.

verseText: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
